lines.text: This document is an extract of a book called Scary
Stories 3. The author name is Alvin Schwartz. It was published
in 1991. The title of the short story is "The bus stop".
It's the story of Ed Cox who's driving home under bad
weather. He suddenly meet Joanna Vinney that needs a ride
home. After a couple of date, she didn't come so Ed tried to
find out where she [X:was] and why she didn't come. At the end, we learnt
she died twenty years ago.
The beginning of the story set a casual experience, that
almost everyone can relate to: the main character is going home
while a rainstorm is happening. There fact that this story
is in a realist context create emotions for the reader like safety.
In fact, from line 1 to 14, the story is calm because Ed is
meeting someone and its going well. The sentences "He saw a
young woman standing alone at a bus stop. She had no umbrella
and was soaking wet" (line 2) create pity for Joanna which can
make her loved by the readers for being helpful at the moment. Line 12 to
13 says "They had such a good time, they went out many times"
show that the two main protagonist start to get close and it set
an atmosphere that can make the reader thinks nothing is going to
happened after those dates. The readers, reading this, can
expect a love story between Ed and Joanna because of
the emotions that are [X:created] created.

page.notes: Two student ratures: 'was' (line 7) and 'created' (line 23, with 'created' rewritten after); no tape; no French words detected.
